verdict.rationale: The evidence documents installing and updating skills (`npx skills add`, `yy skills install`/`update`). It also notes that unrecorded legacy copies are preserved and flagged during updates. Nothing documents a command to list installed skills or to uninstall them cleanly. The update-time copy tracking and the repo-side `validate.mjs` check for retired instructions are adjacent features, not a user-facing list/remove capability. The Ledger ARCHIVE soft-delete concerns tasks, not skills.
